about_the_game:
Missed a scene? A red lock appears and you don’t know why?
This additional content discreetly guides you by showing the conditions required to unlock each missed moment.

With this module, most red locks now display a text that explains what to do to unlock the corresponding scene:
“Have 5 affinity points with the character”, “Explore the laboratory before going to sleep”, etc.

This DLC does not add any erotic content or new scenes.
It serves only as an interactive guide.

Although some help is already available in the gallery to show how to unlock images, this small DLC offers additional, immediate assistance during gameplay.

USAGE: You must save and/or load a game to activate the DLC.

The DLC’s additional option is now available in the game menu, allowing you to enable or disable the display of solutions for red locks at any time (not available in hardcore mode).
